title: Ensure 'Allow user control over installs' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Installer\Allow user control over installs to 'Disabled'
reason: Permits users to change installation options that typically are available only to system administrators. This prevents users from bypassing security features.

title: Ensure 'Always install with elevated privileges' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Installer\Always install with elevated privileges to 'Disabled'
reason: Directs Windows Installer to use system permissions when it installs any program. If enabled, standard users can install malicious applications that affect system-wide configuration.
